scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:track && npm run wasm:demand
scripts.wasm:demand: wasm-pack build ../sim --target web --profile wasm --out-dir ../app/src/wasm/demand --out-name sim -- --no-default-features --features demand && node ../tools/corridor_file.mjs
scripts.wasm:agent: npm run wasm:agent:track && npm run wasm:agent:demand
scripts.wasm:agent:demand: wasm-pack build ../sim --target web --profile agent --out-dir ../app/src/wasm/demand --out-name sim -- --no-default-features --features demand && node ../tools/corridor_file.mjs
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
